verdict.rationale: Drata's own docs say users can automate compliance workflows with custom triggers and actions, and can continuously monitor controls, evidence, and personnel. Custom monitoring tests and custom connections automate evidence collection, which fits background automation. The evidence is mostly one-line marketing blurbs and endpoint names, so the depth of user-configurable autonomous automation is unproven. Missing for 10: detailed docs on the workflow trigger/action builder, scheduling and run behavior, an AI-agent-driven autonomous execution model, and independent hands-on corroboration.
